config.greeting: Lakeside Dental scheduling, good afternoon. How can I help?
replies: Of course, we can move that for you. Could I take your full name, please?
Thank you, Margaret. I can see your Tuesday cleaning — that same week I have Thursday at half past two or four o'clock.
All done: your cleaning is moved to Thursday at half past two. Is there anything else?

traits.personality: Margaret, 68, retired schoolteacher. Polite but easily flustered; asks for things to be repeated and apologises for it.

scenario.instructions: I booked a cleaning for next Tuesday but I need to move it to Thursday that same week. My name is Margaret Hale, sorry to be a bother. The half past two slot would suit me nicely.
